content.title: Urgent In-Vehicle Reaction | Visible Pain, Driver Response, Congestion Hold
content.summary: An injured courier and older river-taxi driver share one urgent blocked-cabin exchange. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Two clearly adult roles share one vehicle geography. + The passenger's visible condition creates the urgency. + One held pause separates reaction turns. + The operator answers with one restrained glance and action. + External congestion remains visible at the endpoint.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one clearly adult injured courier and one older adult driver inside an original compact river taxi cabin. Hold a short pause with other vessels blocking the forward window. End with both adults, the blocked route and the radio action visible in one stable cabin composition.
